items.title: Daphni Shares Surprise New EP hav u a sec
items.summary: Earlier this year, Caribou's Dan Snaith released Butterfly, his latest album under his electronic moniker Daphni. But Snaith's creative momentum hasn't waned. After his latest album, he made the song "hav u a sec," which he initially played during his live set at London's Corsica Studios this past February.

items.title: Rat Cage Announce New Album Not Asking For Much: Hear “Steady On Now”
items.summary: Sheffield's Rat Cage picked the perfect band name, and they went on to make the exact kind of music that the name implies: Fast, raw, frantic, visceral, dirty hardcore punk. You can spot all kinds of early-'80s influences in Rat Cage's guttural attack, but it never feels like pastiche because it's too urgent.

items.title: FREAK NEST Returns After a Decade to Celebrate the Bay Area’s Wild Side
items.summary: FREAK NEST is back. Ten years after the genre-defying gathering first earned near-mythical status in Bay Area music circles, co-founders Taylor Lissandrello and Matthias Wesner are reviving the iconic festival.
